input: add force https redirect to htaccess
how to redirect http to https in htaccess
apache rule to force secure ssl connection

arguments.command:
read -p "📄 .htaccess path (default: ./.htaccess): " path && path=${path:-.htaccess} && tput cuu 1 && termy_say "Adding HTTPS redirect rule" > /dev/null 2>&1 && printf "\r\n" && cat << 'EOF' >> "$path"

# Force HTTPS redirect
RewriteEngine On
RewriteCond %{HTTPS} off
RewriteRule ^(.*)$ https://%{HTTP_HOST}%{REQUEST_URI} [L,R=301]
EOF
 echo "✅ HTTPS redirect rules successfully appended to $path" && printf ""
arguments.explanation: Prompts for the .htaccess file location and appends Apache rules to force redirect all unencrypted traffic to HTTPS.
arguments.goal: Append HTTPS enforcement rewrite rules to an .htaccess file

input: force www prefix in apache htaccess

arguments.command:
read -p "📄 .htaccess path (default: ./.htaccess): " path && path=${path:-.htaccess} && tput cuu 1 && termy_say "Adding WWW prefix rule" > /dev/null 2>&1 && printf "\r\n" && cat << 'EOF' >> "$path"

# Force www prefix
RewriteEngine On
RewriteCond %{HTTP_HOST} !^www\. [NC]
RewriteRule ^(.*)$ https://www.%{HTTP_HOST}/$1 [R=301,L]
EOF
 echo "✅ WWW prefix rules successfully appended to $path" && printf ""
arguments.explanation: Prompts for the .htaccess file location and appends configuration steps to force rewrite URLs to include the www subdomain.
arguments.goal: Append WWW prefix enforcement rewrite rules to an .htaccess file

input: htaccess config for spa react vue routing
htaccess single page application react vue routing
fallback all routes to index.html htaccess
fix 404 on page refresh react router apache

arguments.command:
read -p "📄 .htaccess path (default: ./.htaccess): " path && path=${path:-.htaccess} && tput cuu 1 && termy_say "Adding single page application routing fallback" > /dev/null 2>&1 && printf "\r\n" && cat << 'EOF' >> "$path"

# SPA client side routing fallback
RewriteEngine On
RewriteBase /
RewriteRule ^index\.html$ - [L]
RewriteCond %{REQUEST_FILENAME} !-f
RewriteCond %{REQUEST_FILENAME} !-d
RewriteRule . /index.html [L]
EOF
 echo "✅ SPA client-side routing rules successfully appended to $path" && printf ""
arguments.explanation: Prompts for the .htaccess file location and appends the necessary fallback configurations to prevent 404 errors on Single Page Applications.
arguments.goal: Append client-side routing fallback rules for SPAs to an .htaccess file

input: speed up website with mod_deflate htaccess
compress text html javascript assets apache

arguments.command:
read -p "📄 .htaccess path (default: ./.htaccess): " path && path=${path:-.htaccess} && tput cuu 1 && termy_say "Enabling gzip compression" > /dev/null 2>&1 && printf "\r\n" && cat << 'EOF' >> "$path"

# Enable gzip compression
<IfModule mod_deflate.c>
    AddOutputFilterByType DEFLATE text/html text/plain text/xml text/css text/javascript application/javascript application/json
</IfModule>
EOF
 echo "✅ Gzip compression filters successfully appended to $path" && printf ""
arguments.explanation: Prompts for the .htaccess file location and appends mod_deflate rules to compress code assets for faster network loading speeds.
arguments.goal: Append asset Gzip compression configurations to an .htaccess file

input: add block to specific ip in htaccess
deny access from ip string htaccess

arguments.command:
read -p "📄 .htaccess path (default: ./.htaccess): " path && path=${path:-.htaccess} && read -p "🚫 IP address to block: " ip && tput cuu 1 && termy_say "Blocking target IP address" > /dev/null 2>&1 && printf "\r\n" && cat << EOF >> "$path"

# Block access from specific IP
<RequireAll>
    Require all granted
    Require not ip $ip
</RequireAll>
EOF
 echo "✅ IP restriction block successfully appended to $path" && printf ""
arguments.explanation: Prompts for the .htaccess file location and the target IP, appending specific Apache 2.4 server restriction tags to block its requests.
arguments.goal: Append IP address access blocking rules to an .htaccess file

arguments.command:
tput cuu 1 && termy_say "Generating boilerplate htaccess" > /dev/null 2>&1 && printf "\r\n" && cat << 'EOF' > .htaccess
# Apache Configuration File

# 1. Protect htaccess itself
<Files .htaccess>
    Require all denied
</Files>

# 2. Disable directory browsing
Options -Indexes

# 3. UTF-8 Encoding
AddDefaultCharset UTF-8
EOF
 echo "📄 Created .htaccess boilerplate with security basics" && printf ""
arguments.explanation: Generates a clean .htaccess file in the current directory with baseline security rules (disables directory browsing and blocks direct access to itself).
